"""Intent tests for M1-T13: Snake rules with both views (SNAKE-01 to SNAKE-09, TC-01 to TC-10)."""

import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import numpy as np
import pytest

from rllab.core import SOLO, StepResult
from rllab.envs import COMPACT_FIELDS, Snake

FIXTURES = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "fixtures" / "rllab"

HEAD, BODY, FOOD = 1, 2, 3
HEADINGS = ("up", "right", "down", "left")


def load(tc: str) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
    folder = FIXTURES / tc
    inp = json.loads((folder / "input.json").read_text())
    expected = json.loads((folder / "expected.json").read_text())
    return inp, expected


def start(inp: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Snake, dict[str, np.ndarray], dict[str, float]]:
    env = Snake(view=inp["view"], size=inp["size"])
    env.reset(inp.get("seed", 0))
    obs, info = env.reset_to(
        [tuple(cell) for cell in inp["body"]],
        inp["heading"],
        tuple(inp["food"]),
    )
    return env, obs, info


def act(env: Snake, action: int) -> StepResult:
    return env.step({SOLO: np.array([action], dtype=np.int64)})


def cells(frame: np.ndarray, code: int) -> set[tuple[int, int]]:
    return {(int(r), int(c)) for r, c in np.argwhere(frame == code)}


def heading_of(compact_obs: np.ndarray) -> str:
    flags = {name: compact_obs[i] for i, name in enumerate(COMPACT_FIELDS)}
    on = [h for h in HEADINGS if flags[f"head_{h}"] == 1.0]
    assert len(on) == 1, f"expected exactly one heading flag, got {on}"
    return on[0]


def assert_outcome(result: StepResult, expected: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    assert result.terminated is expected["terminated"]
    assert result.truncated is expected["truncated"]
    assert result.reward[SOLO].shape == (1,)
    assert result.reward[SOLO][0] == pytest.approx(expected["reward"], abs=expected["tol"])
    assert result.info["steps"] == expected["step"]


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc01_wall_ahead_ends_the_game() -> None:
    inp, expected = load("TC-01")
    env, _, _ = start(inp)
    result = act(env, inp["actions"][0])
    assert_outcome(result, expected)
    assert bool(result.done[SOLO][0]) is True
    assert result.info["score"] == expected["score"]
    assert result.info[f"score:{SOLO}"] == expected["score"]


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc02_moving_into_the_body_ends_the_game() -> None:
    inp, expected = load("TC-02")
    env, _, _ = start(inp)
    result = act(env, inp["actions"][0])
    assert_outcome(result, expected)
    assert bool(result.done[SOLO][0]) is True


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc03_moving_into_the_departing_tail_cell_is_legal() -> None:
    inp, expected = load("TC-03")
    env, _, _ = start(inp)
    result = act(env, inp["actions"][0])
    assert_outcome(result, expected)
    assert bool(result.done[SOLO][0]) is False
    frame = env.frame()
    body = [tuple(cell) for cell in expected["body"]]
    assert cells(frame, HEAD) == {body[0]}
    assert cells(frame, BODY) == set(body[1:])
    assert heading_of(result.obs[SOLO][0]) == expected["heading"]


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc04_eating_grows_the_snake_and_scores() -> None:
    inp, expected = load("TC-04")
    env, _, _ = start(inp)
    result = act(env, inp["actions"][0])
    assert_outcome(result, expected)
    assert result.info["score"] == expected["score"]
    frame = env.frame()
    body = [tuple(cell) for cell in expected["body"]]
    assert cells(frame, HEAD) == {body[0]}
    assert cells(frame, BODY) == set(body[1:])
    food = cells(frame, FOOD)
    assert len(food) == 1
    assert food.isdisjoint(body)

def test_tc05_turns_are_relative_to_the_heading() -> None:
    inp, expected = load("TC-05")
    env, _, _ = start(inp)
    result = act(env, inp["actions"][0])
    assert_outcome(result, expected)
    assert cells(env.frame(), HEAD) == {tuple(expected["head"])}
    assert heading_of(result.obs[SOLO][0]) == expected["heading"]


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc06_starvation_truncates_at_100_times_length() -> None:
    inp, expected = load("TC-06")
    env, _, _ = start(inp)
    for step in range(1, expected["not_over_through_step"] + 1):
        result = act(env, inp["repeat_action"])
        assert not result.terminated, f"terminated at step {step}"
        assert not result.truncated, f"truncated at step {step}"
    for _ in range(expected["not_over_through_step"], inp["n_steps"]):
        result = act(env, inp["repeat_action"])
    assert result.info["steps"] == expected["final_step"]
    assert result.truncated is expected["truncated"]
    assert result.terminated is expected["terminated"]
    assert result.reward[SOLO][0] == pytest.approx(expected["reward"], abs=expected["tol"])

def test_tc07_compact_view_of_the_example_board() -> None:
    inp, expected = load("TC-07")
    env, obs, info = start(inp)
    assert env.teams[SOLO].n_agents == 1
    assert tuple(env.teams[SOLO].obs_shape) == (len(COMPACT_FIELDS),)
    assert obs[SOLO].dtype == np.float32
    assert obs[SOLO].shape == (1, len(COMPACT_FIELDS))
    np.testing.assert_allclose(
        obs[SOLO][0], np.array(expected["observation"], dtype=np.float32), atol=expected["tol"]
    )
    assert info["steps"] == 0
    assert info["score"] == 0


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc08_grid_view_marks_head_body_and_food() -> None:
    inp, expected = load("TC-08")
    env, obs, _ = start(inp)
    shape = tuple(expected["shape"])
    assert tuple(env.teams[SOLO].obs_shape) == shape
    assert obs[SOLO].dtype == np.float32
    assert obs[SOLO].shape == (1, *shape)
    want = np.full(shape, expected["elsewhere"], dtype=np.float32)
    for channel, name in enumerate(("head", "body", "food")):
        for r, c in expected["ones"][name]:
            want[channel, r, c] = 1.0
    np.testing.assert_allclose(obs[SOLO][0], want, atol=expected["tol"])


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc09_filling_the_board_is_a_win_without_death_reward() -> None:
    inp, expected = load("TC-09")
    env, _, _ = start(inp)
    result = act(env, inp["actions"][0])
    assert_outcome(result, expected)
    frame = env.frame()
    assert len(cells(frame, HEAD)) + len(cells(frame, BODY)) == expected["length"]


def play(inp: dict[str, Any]) -> list[tuple[bytes, float]]:
    env = Snake(view=inp["view"])
    env.reset(inp["reset_seed"])
    actions = np.random.default_rng(inp["action_seed"]).integers(0, 3, size=inp["n_actions"])
    trace: list[tuple[bytes, float]] = [(env.frame().tobytes(), 0.0)]
    for action in actions:
        result = act(env, int(action))
        trace.append((env.frame().tobytes(), float(result.reward[SOLO][0])))
        if result.terminated or result.truncated:
            break
    return trace


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc10_same_seed_and_actions_same_game() -> None:
    inp, _ = load("TC-10")
    plays = [play(inp) for _ in range(inp["plays"])]
    assert all(p == plays[0] for p in plays[1:])


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc10_start_is_length_3_inside_the_grid_with_food_off_snake() -> None:
    inp, _ = load("TC-10")
    env = Snake(view=inp["view"])
    env.reset(inp["reset_seed"])
    frame = env.frame()
    assert frame.shape == (10, 10)
    assert env.board == "grid"
    assert len(cells(frame, HEAD)) == 1
    assert len(cells(frame, HEAD)) + len(cells(frame, BODY)) == 3
    assert len(cells(frame, FOOD)) == 1


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_stepping_a_finished_game_raises() -> None:
    inp, _ = load("TC-01")
    env, _, _ = start(inp)
    act(env, inp["actions"][0])
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
        act(env, 0)


@pytest.mark.intent
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("body", "food"),
    [
        ([(5, 5), (5, 3), (5, 2)], (0, 0)),
        ([(5, 10), (5, 9), (5, 8)], (0, 0)),
        ([(5, 5), (5, 4), (5, 3)], (5, 4)),
    ],
    ids=["not-contiguous", "leaves-grid", "food-on-snake"],
)
def test_reset_to_rejects_bad_boards(body: list[tuple[int, int]], food: tuple[int, int]) -> None:
    env = Snake(view="compact")
    env.reset(0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"(?i)body|contiguous|grid|food|snake"):

def test_out_of_range_action_raises() -> None:
    inp, _ = load("TC-05")
    env, _, _ = start(inp)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"(?i)action|range"):
        act(env, 3)
